# netactuate_nke_dns_addon (Resource)

Manages a NKE DNS Addon.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_nke_dns_addon" "example" {
  cluster_id = 12345
  zone       = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) The NKE cluster ID
- `zone` (String) DNS zone to attach to the cluster

### Optional

- `channel` (String) Addon channel
- `mode` (String) DNS addon mode
- `version` (String) Addon version

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) Addon display name
- `dns_zone_id` (Number) NKE DNS zone ID
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `installed_on` (String) Addon installation timestamp
- `state` (String) Addon state
- `update_available` (Boolean) Whether an addon update is available

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_nke_dns_addon.example 12345
```
